scope: Native Nexus cold-start scene conversion and connected LBVH/general collision/ordinary joint frames
preconditions: Fresh real Nexus CPU conversion, sleeping disabled, native body/collider parent mappings and offset local poses preserved.
Coulomb friction, three substeps, five PGS iterations, eleven native color buckets and eight native deterministic Topo rounds; all active contacts must be solved.
Two batches of a multi-collider dynamic body, fixed joint endpoint and parentless mesh, with prismatic limits/motors; three batches of 65 independent ball/ground contacts.
Archive built with the pinned noalias-disabled CPU toolchain; geometry and joints use the production converters. Typed storage and dispatch offsets are Rust-derived.
Pair/deferred capacities are explicit. Overflow is an error; the separately registered resident runtime provides retry qualification.

Fresh production RbdPipeline::step traces with deterministic LBVH and the selected contact reduction mode must match all composed Rust oracle body poses and velocities. Native physical inputs match exactly; allocator capacities and deterministic enablement may differ.
Twenty-four independent contact batches cross the 256-element color-bucket prefix boundary. Adjacency and buckets allocate every required scan level from active dimensions.
Coincident triangle subshapes exercise distinct reduced and unreduced native solver paths; unmerged PFM work uses the native identity permutation.
One and two dynamic plates each supported by 33 fixed balls force native hub splitting; the body-slot scan covers the full allocation and solver velocity storage includes the native hub pool.
513 independent batches require 1026 native hub slots; fixture guard body rows must not inflate the native splitting pool.
invariants: Complete generated LBVH, general collision, contact persistence, canonical ordering, body adjacency, contact coloring, joint and contact solve, integration and finalization. No CPU physics between kernels or frames.
Exact IDs, integer counters, writer uniqueness, filtered overlap sets, copied inputs, padding and capacity guards; independent witness, constraint response and cache checks.
All-frame finite states, unit rotations and exact immobility of fixed zero-velocity bodies. Final trace and published body state agree exactly.
Empty BVH leaf bounds preserve the native infinity sentinel bits; only proven-unused leaf slots are normalized in a validation copy. Physical vertices and internal bounds stay finite.
No numerical exceptions: default tolerances apply to all imported scenes.

Native hub reservations are checked by exact totals, membership, contiguous capacity-bounded ownership, body/contact slot identities, and independent scaled mass/inertia. Only verified allocation-dependent link and tile velocity-slot numbers are compared by semantic identity.
outside_scope: Public API lifecycle/control/capacity tests are separate native runtime acceptance gates; this replay checks its bounded uploaded scene or restart. Arbitrary external continuation archives, unbounded Luby coloring and Ascend execution are not certified.
Ascend vendor compilation, execution, synchronization and performance.

known_gaps.description: Implemented by the public Rust TileLangSimulation API: adaptive capacity/coloring, live controls, checkpoints, solver/model changes and scene reconstruction. Native runtime tests and checkpoints 0085-0088, 0096 and 0103 cover these paths; current-source full runtime acceptance remains mandatory under COMPLETION.md. This operation alone does not qualify the public API or Ascend execution.

Open finding from change 0127: the 19-body TileLang comparison example after 12 frames reports maximum position difference 0.025307816 m and linear-velocity difference 2.000419 m/s against the independently stepping Rust CPU reference (mutable noalias disabled). Optimized and previous TileLang Metal schedules produce bitwise-identical buffers in the corresponding controlled 12-frame replay, so performance preservation is established but full production parity is not. Diagnose the first divergent frame/state before closing this gap; do not widen tolerances. See evidence/0127-metal-execution/README.md.
